name: ascii-render-pass
description: A slotted scene renders as live ASCII: a canvas samples the source's luminance grid (rasterized once at mount) and draws glyphs from a density ramp charset; resolution steps coarse to fine as the piece resolves, then holds legible-fine.

vars.description: Density ramp, dark to light. A leading space keeps dark cells empty.
Final cell pitch the resolve lands on.
Seconds from mount start when the coarse-to-fine resolve begins.
Glyph ink: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
Optional departure. Default none: the fine render holds until the frame cuts.
